name: upnext
description: An always-on-top, minimalist to-do app that keeps tasks visible so you capture and finish work faster.
author: Abhishek Ingle (Abhishekingle662)

scripts.release:patch: node increment-version.cjs patch && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: bump to patch version" && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: node increment-version.cjs minor && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: bump to minor version" && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: node increment-version.cjs major && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: bump to major version" && git push origin main --tags
